---
title: "Before you start: setup and your first QC pipeline"
description: "Get your computer ready to run the GWAS pipeline"
---


This page gets your computer ready and walks you through your **first GWAS QC command**. By the end you will have:
- Set up a portable project folder
- Downloaded the demo dataset  
- Installed PLINK2 and PLINK1.9
- Run your first QC script that confirms everything works

::: {.callout-note title="What you will need"}
- A computer running **Windows (with WSL2), macOS, or Linux**
- **30-45 minutes** to complete all setting steps
- **Internet access** to download tools and data
- **optional** Admin rights to install software (or ask your IT team for help)

You do **not** need any programming experience. Every command is provided in full with alternatives and troubleshooting information.
:::

## A note on the command line {#sec-terminal}

Most steps in this guide are typed into a **terminal** (also called a "command line" or "console") — a window where you type a command, press <kbd>Enter</kbd>, and the program runs.

- **Windows:** You must use **WSL2 terminal** (see Step 0). WSL2 gives you Linux inside Windows.
- **macOS:** Open the *Terminal* app (in *Applications → Utilities*).
- **Linux:** Open your *Terminal*.
- **Inside RStudio:** there is a *Terminal* tab next to the *Console* tab — you can use that too.

Throughout the guide, lines you type into the terminal look like this:

```bash
bash scripts/01_initial_qc_stats.sh
```

Copy the command, paste it into your terminal, and press <kbd>Enter</kbd>. That's it.

---

## Step 0 — Prepare your operating system {#sec-os-setup}

Before you begin, set up your OS environment.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Windows: Install WSL2 (Required)

**WSL2** (Windows Subsystem for Linux) gives you a Linux environment inside Windows. The GWAS pipeline uses bash scripts, so WSL2 is required.

**Part A: Install WSL2**

1. Open **PowerShell as Administrator** (right-click and select "Run as administrator")
2. Run:
   ```powershell
   wsl --install
   ```
3. Restart your computer when prompted

**Part B: Open WSL2 Terminal**

1. After restart, open **Windows Terminal** (search for it in the Start menu)
2. Click the dropdown arrow and select **Ubuntu**
3. You should see a bash prompt like `user@computer:~$`

**Part C: Install Basic Tools**

In the WSL2 bash terminal, run:
```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install git curl wget
```

✅ **WSL2 is now ready. From here on, all commands use this bash terminal.**

For help troubleshooting WSL2, see [WSL_SETUP.md](docs/helpers/WSL_SETUP.md).

### macOS and Linux

Your system already has bash. No setup needed for Step 0.

:::

---

## Step 1 — Create your project folder {#sec-project-folder}

Choose any location on your computer and create a folder named `gwas_tutorial`. This will be your **working folder** for the entire pipeline.

```bash
mkdir -p ~/gwas_tutorial
cd ~/gwas_tutorial
```

> **Tip:** You can place this folder anywhere: Desktop, Documents, custom path — it doesn't matter. Everything is portable because we use relative paths.

---

## Step 2 — Create the directory structure {#sec-directories}

Create the folder structure that keeps scripts, data, and tools organized.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Automated (Easiest)

Download and run the setup script:

```bash
# Download the automated setup script
wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/main/init_project.sh

# Run it
bash init_project.sh
```

This creates all folders automatically.

### Manual with mkdir

Create folders manually:

```bash
# Create all needed folders
mkdir -p \
    scripts \
    demo_data \
    tools/bin \
    data_processed \
    results/{qc,pop_structure,imputation,association,finemapping,meta_analysis}
```

:::

Your folder now looks like this:

```
gwas_tutorial/
├── scripts/
│   ├── dev/                         # Utility scripts
│   │   ├── download_demo_data.sh
│   │   ├── tools_setup.sh
│   │   ├── test.sh
│   │   └── init_project.sh
│   ├── 01B_genotyping_qc/           # QC scripts
│   │   ├── 01_initial_qc_stats.sh
│   │   ├── 02_sample_callrate.sh
│   │   └── ...09_qc_summary.sh
│   ├── 02_population_stratification/
│   ├── 03_imputation/
│   └── ...other sections...
├── demo_data/                       # Demo dataset (Step 4)
├── tools/bin/                       # Tools (eg PLINK, Step 5)
├── data_processed/                  # Processed output files
└── results/                         # Results organized by workflow
```

---

## Step 3 — Download the GWAS scripts {#sec-scripts}

Clone the GitHub repo to get all the GWAS pipeline scripts organized by section:

```bash
# Clone the repo (temporary)
git clone https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac.git

# Copy section scripts directly into section folders
for section_dir in how-to-gwas-pdac/sections/*/; do
  section=$(basename "$section_dir")
  mkdir -p "scripts/$section"
  cp "$section_dir/scripts"/* "scripts/$section/"
done

# Copy utility/dev scripts
cp how-to-gwas-pdac/scripts/dev/* scripts/dev/

# Clean up
rm -rf how-to-gwas-pdac
```

Verify the scripts downloaded:

```bash
# Check QC scripts
ls scripts/01B_genotyping_qc/
```

You should see: `01_initial_qc_stats.sh` through `09_qc_summary.sh`

And utility scripts:

```bash
ls scripts/dev/
```

You should see: `download_demo_data.sh`, `tools_setup.sh`, `test.sh`, `init_project.sh`

---

## Step 4 — Download the demo dataset {#sec-data}

Download the 7 demo dataset files (~164 MB total) to your `demo_data/` folder.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Automated (Easiest)

Run the download script from your project:

```bash
bash scripts/dev/download_demo_data.sh
```

This downloads all 7 files automatically and verifies them.

### Manual with wget

Download files individually:

```bash
cd ~/gwas_tutorial  # Make sure you're in your project folder

# Download all 7 files
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/pdac_demo.bed -O demo_data/pdac_demo.bed
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/pdac_demo.bim -O demo_data/pdac_demo.bim
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/pdac_demo.fam -O demo_data/pdac_demo.fam
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/phenotype.txt -O demo_data/phenotype.txt
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/covariates.txt -O demo_data/covariates.txt
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/survival.txt -O demo_data/survival.txt
wget https://github.com/mgentiluomo/how-to-gwas-pdac/releases/download/v0.1-data/sample_ancestry.tsv -O demo_data/sample_ancestry.tsv
```

:::

Verify the files downloaded:

```bash
ls -lh demo_data/
```

You should see all 7 files.

::: {.callout-tip title="File Integrity Check"}
The download script automatically verifies the SHA256 hash of each file to ensure they were downloaded correctly. You should see messages like:
```
✓ OK: pdac_demo.bed
✓ OK: pdac_demo.bim
...
✓ All files verified successfully! (7/7)
```

If any file fails verification, the script will tell you which one and suggest re-downloading it. This built-in verification ensures your data is safe and ready for analysis.
:::

## Step 5 — Install dependencies {#sec-install}

Install PLINK2, PLINK1.9, and other required tools.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Automated (Easiest)

Run the setup script from your project:

```bash
bash scripts/dev/tools_setup.sh
```

The script will:
- Download PLINK2 to `tools/bin/`
- Download PLINK1.9 to `tools/bin/`
- Configure your PATH so both are accessible

### Manual Installation

Install tools manually if you prefer. **PLINK** is the workhorse program for genotype data. We use **PLINK 2** (the command is `plink2`). It is a single program file — there is **no installer**: you download it, unzip it, and you are done.

#### PLINK 2

1. Go to the official download page: <https://www.cog-genomics.org/plink/2.0/>
2. Download the build for your operating system (Linux / macOS / Windows).
3. **Unzip** it. Inside you will find the program file: `plink2` (macOS/Linux) or `plink2.exe` (Windows).

::: {.callout-tip title="The simplest setup"}
Put the `plink2` (or `plink2.exe`) file **in the same folder as your tools**
(`tools/bin/`). Then you can run it as `plink2` without worrying about installation paths. More advanced users can instead add PLINK to their system `PATH`.
:::

#### Other tools

*(Coming soon — instructions for PLINK 1.9, R, and other dependencies)*

:::

## Step 6 — Test tools and scripts {#sec-first-run}

Run the test script to verify everything is installed and working:

```bash
bash scripts/dev/test.sh
```

This script will:
1. Check installed tools (PLINK2, PLINK1.9)
2. Load the demo dataset
3. Print the next command to run

When it finishes, you should see output like:

```
✓ Initial test done! PLINK2 and PLINK1.9 are working, and the demo dataset is accessible.
Next command: bash scripts/01B_genotyping_qc/01_initial_qc_stats.sh
```

If you see this message, **everything is working!** 🎉 You can now proceed to the next QC step.

## Troubleshooting {#sec-troubleshooting}

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="`git: command not found`"}
Git is not installed on your system.

**Solution (Windows WSL2):**
```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install git
```

**Solution (macOS):**
```bash
brew install git
```

**Solution (Linux):**
```bash
sudo apt-get install git
```
:::

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="`wget: command not found`"}
wget is not installed.

**Solution (Windows WSL2 / Linux):**
```bash
sudo apt-get install wget
```

**Solution (macOS):**
```bash
brew install wget
```
:::

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="`plink: command not found` or `plink2: command not found`"}
PLINK is not installed or not on your PATH.

**Solution:** The `tools_setup.sh` script should have installed PLINK to `tools/bin/`. Check if it's there:

```bash
ls tools/bin/
```

If you don't see `plink` and `plink2`, re-run the setup:
```bash
bash scripts/dev/tools_setup.sh
```

If PLINK is there but still not found, your PATH may not be set. Add it manually:
```bash
export PATH="$(pwd)/tools/bin:$PATH"
plink --version  # Test
```
:::

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="`Error: Failed to open pdac_demo.bed`"}
PLINK cannot find the demo dataset.

**Solution:** Make sure all demo files were downloaded:
```bash
ls demo_data/pdac_demo.*
```

You should see `.bed`, `.bim`, and `.fam` files. If any are missing, re-run Step 4:
```bash
bash scripts/dev/download_demo_data.sh
```
:::

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="`Permission denied` when running a script"}
The script file doesn't have execute permissions.

**Solution:**
```bash
chmod +x scripts/*/
bash scripts/01B_genotyping_qc/01_initial_qc_stats.sh
```
:::

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true" title="Script not found or can't find data files"}
You're in the wrong directory or files are missing.

**Solution:**
```bash
# Make sure you're in your project folder
cd ~/gwas_tutorial

# Check files exist
ls scripts/01B_genotyping_qc/
ls demo_data/

# Then run the first QC script
bash scripts/01B_genotyping_qc/01_initial_qc_stats.sh
```
:::
